Noto Sans Regular

NotoSans-OFL.txt

Noto Sans CJK SC Regular
SIL Open Font License 1.1. Copyright 2014–2021 Adobe.
Exact font metadata and full license: NotoSansCJK-OFL.txt
Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
The repository stores this original font losslessly in two binary chunks.
Preparation reconstructs and verifies the identical font; its license is unchanged.

QFT PDF sample PDF
The original sample text/layout and application illustrations were created for
QFT PDF and are covered by the application MIT license. The sample embeds Noto
Sans and Noto Serif subsets, which retain OFL-1.1; font notices are included in
NotoSans-OFL.txt. Using these fonts does not put generated documents under OFL.

Verification records and reproducible notice-audit scripts are included in the
source repository at https://github.com/renphysics/pdf.qft.org.
Runtime packages were verified against their exact official release artifacts.
This notice index distinguishes application licensing from third-party terms;
it does not relicense third-party code, fonts, metrics or profiles under MIT.
